description: This file defines the SwiftUI view 'ContextMenuCardView' used for displaying a context usage card in the macOS menu bar, including session rows and placeholder views.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes ContextMenuCardView with session rows, optional status text, and loading state.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the main view layout for the context menu card.

methods.name: subtitle
methods.description: Computes the subtitle string based on session count.

methods.name: sessionRow
methods.description: Builds a view for a session row, including usage bar and textual information.

methods.name: placeholderRow
methods.description: Builds a placeholder view for loading state.
